pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped polygonal patches with moderately sharp edge gradients and jagged boundaries. Geometry transition from larger, elongated forms on the neck to smaller, more compact polygons on the posterior flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of off-white pathways forming clear junction nodes at patch intersections. Corridors maintain a relatively uniform pixel thickness, creating a web-like topological structure.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette along the dorsal line of the neck, representing the mane. The contour is consistent with small, regular pixel-level protrusions.
